topic: be kind to yourself when you mess up
lines: You broke the streak. Said the wrong *thing.* Spent the money.
#And now the voice in your head is *loud.*
#Would you talk to a friend like that?
Would you call someone you *love* a failure for one bad day?
So why do you talk to *yourself* like that?
#Being hard on yourself doesn't make you *better.*
Growth says, that was a *mistake.* Let's fix it.
Own it. Learn from it. Make it right if you *can.*
One bad day doesn't erase a hundred good *ones.*
#You're allowed to be a work in *progress.*
And this time, start as your own *friend.*
end: Send this to someone who's too hard on themselves.

post.title: You Messed Up. Now What?
post.caption: Shame makes you quit. Growth makes you better. Be your own friend. 🤍
post.first_comment: What would you tell a friend who messed up today? 👇
